notes: Exact lines from the PDF: 'Social media commands the largest share of digital ad spends at 29% (Rs 21,057 crore)' and 'Paid search contributes 23% (Rs 16,581 crore), reflecting its continued importance in intent-led...'. Supports the 'three platforms, three jobs' slide: social (Meta, LinkedIn) and search (Google) are the two biggest buckets Indian advertisers pay for. Online video is the third (report says it reaches 29% by end-2026, a projection).

claim_as_shown: The Pitch Madison Advertising Report 2026 puts digital at 60% of India's advertising market in 2025 and forecasts 64% in 2026.
title: India's ad economy crosses digital milestone, 64% share projected for 2026: PMAR (exchange4media, 24 Feb 2026, reporting the Pitch Madison Advertising Report 2026)
notes: Corroborating figure, near-primary: Pitch is exchange4media's own title, so this is the publisher's own write-up. Exact lines: 'Digital's share of the expanded advertising economy is expected to rise from 60 percent in 2025 to 64 percent in 2026' and 'Digital ADEX is forecast to grow from Rs 93,156 crores to Rs 1,11,976 crores in 2026'. Caveat: PMAR's 'expanded' definition adds quick-commerce and MSME digital spend; on its legacy definition digital is 46% and traditional 54% (Social Samosa, 18 Feb 2026, same report). The report PDF sits behind a form at e4mevents.com and could not be opened. Recommendation: lead with dentsu-e4m 59% on the slide and say in notes that PMAR 2026 lands at about 60% on its wider definition. Do not show both numbers on one slide. Headless capture of the article was blocked by an interstitial ad, so no screenshot.
